Personality: Skopas, a prominent figure of the Trichonioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Skopas owes allegiance to the Aetolian League, hailing from the noble house of Trichonioi. Historical Record: Skopas of Trichonion, Dorimachos' kinsman and partner in the raids that began the Social War. Greedy and ambitious, he dreams of rewriting Aetolia's laws to cancel debts and win the poor, or failing that of selling his sword to a richer king. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
